case.subject: KRG Oil Company
case.problem: Manual analysis of business growth opportunities and financial planning was time-consuming and limited the ability to evaluate new product lines.
case.workflow: The owner developed an AI agent with a colleague, originally to manage emails. She now provides it with new instructions to ingest financial data, analyze potential business pivots (such as adding solar infrastructure to fuel tanks), and generate strategic growth blueprints for her review.
case.result: The agent delivered a concrete, actionable blueprint for an entirely new product line of tanks with additional services, acting as a force multiplier for the owner's strategic planning.
case.result_basis: Reported by the company owner, Marie Hunter, in an interview with Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses.
case.measurement_context: Transition from manual financial analysis to AI-supported strategic planning for business expansion.
case.source_quote: Rather than analyzing the cost of customizing a few fuel storage tanks for select customers, the agent delivered an ambitious blueprint for a new business.
case.limitation: Results are based on personal account from the business owner; internal implementation details of the agent's logic were not publicly disclosed.
case.listener_action: Identify one recurring strategic or financial analysis task and pilot a small AI agent setup to draft options for your review before acting.
case.availability: Current; developed by the business owner and colleague.
